protocol: Stage 9J route-quality validation set. Labels were assigned from textbook chemistry BEFORE the assessor was run on these routes. NOT independent: the author also wrote the assessor and chose these cases knowing the assessor's check families. Labels: flag = a competent chemist would reject or seriously qualify the step as drawn; clear = a standard textbook transformation that should not be rejected; not-supported = plausible structure but the outcome is not determined by the engine (must not be called chemically-supported); ambiguous = reasonable chemists differ, reported but not scored. 'fabricated' steps are deliberately impossible (product atoms not derivable from the reactants) and test atom sourcing / replay.

cases.label: flag
cases.why: Free aniline brominates at all activated positions; mono-4-bromination needs N-protection (Clayden ch.21; Wade ch.17).

cases.label: flag
cases.why: Phenol is so activated that Br2 over-brominates (tribromophenol in water); mono-bromination needs low T / non-polar solvent without catalyst.

cases.label: flag
